description: A tax engine module under shared/billingClients calculates tax with an explicit knexOrTrx and tenant and imports no session, tenant-context or packages/billing code

The engine covers tax exemption, reverse charge, the region path with per-rate caps, the client default rate, composite rates, threshold brackets, tax holidays, and date and currency filters, using the TaxService arithmetic
The engine returns an unresolved result with reason, region and date for a taxable amount whose region has no active rate
The engine reads a client with no client_tax_settings row as default settings and inserts nothing
The engine resolves client tax settings per billing profile, defaulting to the client's default profile
TaxService.calculateTax and calculateTaxForPeriod call the engine and raise NO_TAX_RATE with today's message and details for an unresolved result
TaxService callers get the same results as before, and the calculation path no longer provisions default tax settings
quoteCalculationService resolves row tax through the engine, and calculateTaxWithConnection and its bracket, component and holiday helpers are deleted
crmWorkerDal quote recalculation calls the engine, its tax copy is deleted, and the quote-recalc-dup LEVERAGE marker is updated
The workflow worker import validation passes with the engine imported
Migration adds quote_items.tax_unresolved boolean not null default false
Quote recalculation sets tax_unresolved and stores 0 tax for a taxable row the engine could not resolve, and clears it otherwise
Quote item reads (actions and REST) include tax_unresolved
Converting a quote to an invoice through the action, REST or workflow path is refused with the NO_TAX_RATE message while an included one-time row is unresolved
The quote line editor shows a warning with the region's name on a line with unresolved tax
The quote totals show a note when any included line has unresolved tax
